profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with experience building scalable, accessible enterprise web applications and shared UI platforms. Combines an entrepreneurial mindset with strong frontend engineering skills to deliver intuitive, reliable user experiences. Passionate about clean architecture, accessibility, and building products that are both technically sound and thoughtfully designed. Outside of work, draws inspiration from music, art, design, fitness, and cooking.

Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built reusable frontend modules and components for Facebook’s internal CMS, supporting Facebook
global marketing campaigns used by teams worldwide.
- Partnered with solutions engineers, products, marketing, and design team to ship new features and

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and enhanced features using J.P.Morgan Chase & Co.’s proprietary JavaScript framework for large
scale financial applications.
- Developed shared features for both browsers and mobile apps and ensured all shipped code is fully
ADA compliant for accessibility.

positions.title: Software Development Technical Instructor
positions.description:
- Instructed 100+ students in full-stack software development, covering from introductory javascript to
advanced web development, data structures, and algorithms.
- Conducted monthly mock interviews a/A alumni on technical interview questions with whiteboarding
problems. Providing detailed feedback on whiteboarding, code quality and optimization strategies,
helping students prepare for industry roles.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
- Co-founded and operated an international cosmetic manufacturing and distribution company serving
clients across North America, Europe and Asia.
- Managed and designed Shopify e-commerce website with daily 500+ unique visitors to provide retail service and increase brand awareness of cosmetic products handled.
- Led sales eﬀort and delivered client pitches at major global beauty conventions, including, Las Vegas,
Bologna, New York, Seoul, Hong Kong, and Long Beach.

positions.title: Purchasing Coordinator
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
- Purchased mechanical, electrical, civil and chemical products used for building US military facilities oversea.
- Managed and organized weekly imports and exports, and their appropriate documentations. 
- Processed letter of credit and other payment methods for purchases and exports.

projects.title: Experience Premier
projects.description:
Demo B2B website that records conversations and display their sentiment analysis to evaluate and improve customer experience

- Applied SpeechRecognition interface from Web Speech API to record and transform conversations to live transcripts
- Incorporated IBM Watson’s Natural Language Understanding API to analyze transcripts on backend and sent the translated data to frontend
- Formulated original idea and documented state shape and schema in order to inform teammates about the design process

projects.title: LetterNote
projects.description:
A single page web-application clone of note-taking app, Evernote.
Tech used: HTML / SCSS / Ruby / Rails / JavaScript / React.js / React-Quill / Redux / Webpack.
- Ensured user’s credentials by using BCrypt for the backend and React Auth route for the frontend. 
- Used debounce of lodash to save users input when a user stops inputting for 1 second to minimize the incoming data traffic and to save user’s input as frequently as possible. 
- Implemented Quill-enabled text editing functionalities to provide users with its rich text-editing experience and connected user’s edit input to corresponding note database through React and Redux.
